concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑003 requires verification that the pipeline runs on **2 CPU cores**. The only profiling task (T012) checks RAM and wall‑clock time, leaving the core‑count requirement untested.

The implementation plan lists two contracts (`counterfactual_pair.schema.yaml` and `evaluation_results.schema.yaml`), but no task explicitly validates the generated CSV/JSON files against these schemas.
